name: Stop-Motion Animation
visualIdentity: Physical-looking objects with stable materials, deliberate lighting, contact shadows, and clear space. Held frames and incremental poses convey weight. Preserve controlled craft qualities without accidental defects. Authentic stop motion is photographed frame by frame; digital keyframes are a simulation.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to craft films and product launches; process documentaries and educational craft content also suit handwritten annotations. Isometric miniatures, dioramas, paper craft, collage, and layered 2.5D are compatible when projection, contact, and legibility hold. Interactive HTML can use frame sequences with text overlays; this is an inferred extension, not an explicit style claim.
limitations: Needs photographed frames for authentic production; no renderer is listed, so use supplied frames or disclose a Blender simulation. Avoid camera tilt that breaks isometric projection, exposed incomplete layers, broken ground contact, obscured labels, or depth that harms readability. No intrinsic palette, fixed audio, or motion reference is required; unspecified.
palette: No canonical palette is specified. Preserve the actual object, set, material, artwork, brand, and reference colors. Optional neutral presentation tokens for new elements only: background #ECE4D4, foreground #3C443C, accent #917F67; keep them discrete, with no gradients. Accent with background text has contrast 3.057 and is decorative only; the foreground/background pair is 7.972, but verify actual compositing and text size.
motionAndInteraction: Plan held states and pose exposure cadence separately from delivery frame rate; avoid automatic in-betweens and generic smoothing. For video, derive state from seekable composition time and ensure deterministic direct, backward, and sequential playback. Interactive HTML may add restrained pointer parallax or scroll-driven chapters/story states when scene geometry and narrative support them; provide neutral/resting states, reversible progress, reading holds, keyboard/touch and reduced-motion behavior. Keep labels fixed and readable; use one owner per animated property.
audio: No fixed genre, tempo, voice, or required layer. Choose music, narration, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied choices, leave space for reading and speech, and synchronize to the action. Pattern-specific sound is optional. Verify intelligibility, balance, clipping, and picture sync.
assetRequirements: Authentic work requires repositioned objects photographed frame by frame, then aligned and corrected. Composition inputs may be transparent layers or clearly named numbered frames with consistent dimensions. Inspect assets, margins, grounding, and occlusion. Python/Pillow can preprocess and composite assets; FFmpeg can encode sequences and combine audio. Blender is an explicitly labeled simulation option, not evidence of physical capture.
combinations: Optional stepped title/caption typography can support craft films if it shares the exposure cadence, uses negative space, and does not cover key objects or shadows; avoid smooth high-rate text and ubiquitous spring motion. Handwritten process callouts suit educational or behind-the-scenes pieces when shown only during holds, pointer first then note, with restrained ink colors. Parallax, chapter transitions, and scrollytelling are conditional patterns, not defaults; use only when supported by actual geometry and story.
productionApproach: Choose visual construction and motion methods from fidelity, action, and assets before the export pipeline. HyperFrames is primary for assembly, seekable timing, media/audio sync, validation, and export; Remotion is fallback only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required capability, with reason recorded. GSAP may provide a paused seekable timeline. Keep specialist rendering separate, cache or deterministically replay state, inspect key frames and the decoded full video, then verify dimensions, duration, frame rate, sync, and loop continuity. These are suggested routes, not claims about the source's actual tools.
